title: Bazel failed action output tail
description: Schema-first contract of the output tail a failed Bazel action leaves behind. Bazel's own console echo of an action's output is capped (`--experimental_ui_max_stdouterr_bytes`, 1 MiB by default) and skips a larger output entirely, so the repo adapter never relies on it: the action keeps the last `maximumTailBytes` bytes of its combined stdout and stderr (never cut inside a UTF-8 sequence) and, when it fails, writes them into the run's `directory` as one file per task; the invoking process reads those files after the build failed and prints them in the authored language.

Policy.description: Authored numbers. `maximumTailBytes`: the bounded tail kept per task. `directory`: the failure directory inside the generated package of the selection. `fileSuffix`: every tail file ends with it. `maximumFiles`: the most tail files one failure report reads. `maximumHeaderBytes`: the bound of the one JSON header line that starts a tail file.

Header.description: The first line of a tail file: the task id, the kept tail size and the number of earlier bytes that were dropped. The remaining bytes of the file are the tail itself.

Messages.description: Failure report lines in English and German; `{name}` placeholders are replaced by the reported values.

en.failed: [bazel] task {task} failed; last {bytes} bytes of its output ({dropped} earlier bytes omitted), saved to {file}:
en.complete: [bazel] task {task} failed; its complete output ({bytes} bytes), saved to {file}:

de.failed: [bazel] Task {task} fehlgeschlagen; letzte {bytes} Bytes ihrer Ausgabe ({dropped} frühere Bytes ausgelassen), gesichert in {file}:
de.complete: [bazel] Task {task} fehlgeschlagen; ihre vollständige Ausgabe ({bytes} Bytes), gesichert in {file}:
